args.title: Juniper Labware: Warehouse Automation in 2026 — Summary
args.body:
- Juniper Labware's latest newsletter features "Warehouse automation in 2026," linking to a blog article plus a companion piece accessible via free email registration.
- Main article: pick rates rose 18% with autonomous carts, but integration took twice as long as planned.
- Companion piece: the biggest saving was fewer mis-picks.
